description.value: Lakeside provincial campground in Birkenhead Lake Park reached via 17 km of gravel road, set among old-growth forest with mountain views across the lake; bears are very active and the gravel approach is rough for loaded bikes.

raw_osm.name: Birkenhead Lake Provincial Campsite
raw_osm.operator: Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active, bookable frontcountry campground with a 'Book camping' button and coverage under the BC Parks reservation system; the OSM tag power_supply=no is corroborated by the website's general statement that 'most parks lack internet connectivity' and no electrical amenities are mentioned anywhere on the page. The website explicitly states access requires a 17 km gravel road from the highway, which is significant for touring cyclists. No specific amenity details (showers, potable water, food storage, etc.) are listed for this individual park page, so those fields default to null.
concerns: Access requires 17 km of gravel road from the nearest highway junction — likely unsuitable for road touring cyclists.

OSM phone number (+1-604-986-9371) is the park operator's (Sea to Sky Park Services) line; the BC Parks website contact page lists different general BC Parks numbers (1-800-689-9025 toll-free). Operator number not explicitly shown on the park's own page.
No civic address in OSM record.
Grizzly and black bears described as 'very active' in the park — notable safety consideration for cyclists camping here.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The campground is a legitimate, active BC Parks facility with 91 sites and reservation support, but the mandatory 17 km unpaved gravel road approach from the highway makes it impractical for road touring cyclists and limits appeal to gravel/bikepacking riders; a human reviewer should determine whether this fits the directory's scope.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM also records sanitary_dump_station=yes, relevant for self-contained vehicle campers. The operator email info@seatoskyparks.com is for Sea to Sky Park Services, not BC Parks directly (BC Parks contact is parkinfo@gov.bc.ca).

wow_evidence: mandatory 17 km unpaved gravel road approach from the highway
